scene: One continuous evening planning conversation at home. Mom stays seated screen left and Child stays seated screen right on nearby chairs, facing each other in a locked 16:9 medium two-shot. No essential props; both have empty hands. Park, swings, library, rain and animal books are future possibilities mentioned in speech, never visible destinations or activities. No flashback montage, no extra voices, no imagined-location cutaways, thought bubbles, generated books or weather effects. Small illustrative hand gestures only; stay in this same home setting with unchanged lighting and no time jump.

emotion.baseline: Calm, warm and regulated baseline; Mom and Child make an ordinary family decision together at natural conversation volume.
emotion.allowed_shift: A small pleased smile for the park choice, a brief thoughtful pause for rain, and a relaxed nod as they agree. Mom gives Child room to contribute without testing or prompting a memorized answer.
emotion.forbidden: No cheering, disappointment tantrum, fear of rain, frantic swinging or pretending to travel, dramatic weather change or triumphant agreement pose. Keep faces and bodies proportionate and gestures small.

A.start: Mom remains seated screen left and Child seated screen right at home in evening light, facing each other with empty hands resting near their laps.
A.action: Mom offers two destinations with a small open-palm gesture. Child chooses the park and gives his reason with a modest smile, keeping his body still rather than imitating a swing. Mom acknowledges his preference. No destination appears and neither character looks toward an imagined location.
A.end: Mom and Child remain seated in the same home positions with empty hands near their laps after agreeing that the park sounds appealing.

B.start: Mom and Child remain seated in the same home positions with empty hands near their laps after agreeing that the park sounds appealing.
B.action: Mom introduces rain as a possible condition in normal conversation, then listens. After a brief thoughtful pause, Child offers the library with one small open-hand gesture. Mom accepts indoor reading as the alternative. No rain starts, no lighting changes, and no one supplies Child's proposal for him.
B.end: Mom and Child remain seated at home with empty hands lowered near their laps after agreeing on the library as the rainy-day alternative.

C.start: Mom and Child remain seated at home with empty hands lowered near their laps after agreeing on the library as the rainy-day alternative.
C.action: Child adds his interest in animal books while looking at Mom. Mom agrees and restates the dry-weather park and rainy-weather library options with a small two-option hand gesture. Child gives one relaxed confirming nod during his final turn. End with a shared plan, without books, travel, pretend reading or additional speech.
C.end: Mom and Child remain seated in the unchanged home setting with empty hands relaxed near their laps, sharing a calm look after confirming tomorrow's conditional plan.
